card.text: A star 85% of the Sun's width that turns once in 3.7 days, with a mapped magnetic field.

introduction.text: Folsom et al. give it 0.85 solar radii, 0.8 solar masses, a rotation period of 3.7 days and an axis tilted 60° from the line of sight.

color.title: Photosphere color
color.summary: The color of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.

radial-field-2013-05.title: Radial field, May 2013
radial-field-2013-05.summary: The star's magnetic field, mapped in this project from archived spectra by how it polarises starlight.
